title: Silent Terror
stack: Angular · Python / FastAPI · MySQL · Docker · SVM · Fuzzy Logic · Ollama
description:
An ongoing university project exploring conversational AI through a social-deduction game prototype. Players exchange alibis and look for a hidden Hitman, while NOX joins the discussion as an AI game character. The current prototype supports login, room creation and joining, and room-based chat.

As team lead, full-stack developer, and AI researcher, I contribute across project coordination, frontend and backend development, database and Docker setup, and AI research and experimentation.

Built with Angular, a Python/FastAPI backend, Socket.IO, MySQL, and Docker. The AI pipeline combines SVM intent classification with fuzzy-logic suspicion scoring to inform contextual bot responses. It supports OpenAI API integration and downloaded Qwen3 models running locally through Ollama.

My exploration includes Naive Bayes, SVM, TF-IDF, transformers, and fuzzy logic, alongside learning how LLM inference, conversation context, model size, and local CPU/GPU deployment work beyond API calls.

Still in development: the current experience focuses on chat and AI experimentation; the round engine, role actions, voting, and win conditions are not yet active.
